title: Redis & Caching
intro: Redis and caching interviews test whether you understand the cache as a system with its own failure modes. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with Redis data structures (the primitives — strings, lists, sets, hashes, sorted sets), then caching strategies (cache-aside, read-through, write-through) and patterns. Cache invalidation — the hardest problem — follows, then Redis persistence and the Spring Data Redis code tier. Caffeine (the in-process cache), distributed caching, and Redis advanced features (Lua, pub/sub, streams) are the advanced tier. It closes with performance optimization, comparisons, and scenario-based questions.
